summary: Selects one of four track-environment physics profiles by the track-type selector at this+0x3B40 and initializes a dense run of per-parameter slots on the object. In each of the first two profiles every slot is written with a profile-specific default literal, read against its lower/upper bound fields, and clamped via FloatClamp or ClampByRange; a nested 2x8 per-wheel array (element base this+0x402C, 36-byte stride) is initialized the same way. The remaining two profiles push the same defaults through the ClampedFloatSetter_1de0 / ArithmeticComparison_20d0 helper pair instead of direct field writes, then repeat a per-wheel 2x8 loop of setter calls. A profile outside 0-3 returns immediately without touching any field.
